body:
RE-SCOPED 2026-09-19 after the lane measured the ticket's original premises at HEAD and DISPROVED them. GitHub issue #1042 still carries the disproved claims; this ticket supersedes it.

WHAT WAS DISPROVED (measured):
1. "SIGTERM cannot preempt a synchronous blocking read" is FALSE for this hook. plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs registers NO signal handler, so the kernel default action terminates it even inside readFileSync(0). Measured: hook spawned with an open stdin pipe, alive at 600ms, SIGTERM -> signalCode SIGTERM within 300ms. The old justification is not restated in code, commits or the PR.
2. The 63 test spawn sites CANNOT produce the deadlock. AST analysis of every execFileSync/spawnSync of process.execPath in both hook test dirs: 60 pass input:, the remaining 3 use pipe/ignore stdio, ZERO inherit stdin, and there are no async spawn/execFile/fork calls there. Node writes the payload and closes the pipe deterministically, so the hook always reaches EOF. Running the exact unbounded shape the issue describes returns immediately with exit 2 (failing closed), not a hang.
3. The suites leak nothing: claude-code hooks 283/284 (the 1 was the lane's own RED), codex hooks 157/157, hook processes before == after.

WHY THE TICKET STILL EXISTS. The observed leak is real (29 hung trees, oldest 20 days, orphaned at ppid=1, cwd on a deleted worktree) but its mechanism is NOT the test path, and is now tracked separately as its own diagnosis issue. Independent corroboration for that split: the hung leaves were parked in kernel wait channel unix_stream_data_wait, which is a UNIX SOCKET; execFileSync(..., {input}) gives a child a PIPE. The blocked fd 0 therefore did not come from these call sites at all.

THIS TICKET IS DEFENCE-IN-DEPTH: insurance against a future unbounded spawn, not a fix for a reproduced hang. A timeout on a test spawn is enforced by the parent process, and the observed orphans had no live parent, so this work would not have prevented them.

DESIGN DECISIONS:
- One shared runHook helper per hook-test directory rather than 63 individually patched call sites, so a new test cannot reintroduce an unbounded spawn. Shape: execFileSync(process.execPath, [HOOK, ...args], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS, ...opts }) with HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000.
- killSignal on the helper and on the adlc-hook-run.mjs spawn is optional. Its only basis is consistency with boundedHandoffRead in adlc-hook.mjs, which bounds a child that may sit in a blocking read; the disproved SIGTERM claim is not a basis. If an existing wrapper test depends on SIGTERM, SIGTERM stays.
- The drift guard parses STRUCTURALLY (not string equality) in the style of scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs, scripts/test/ceremony-drift.test.mjs and scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs.
- Out of scope: bounding readStdin() itself (adlc-hook.mjs is a rail). Its comment at lines 118-125 records that chunked reads and an EAGAIN retry loop were tried and rejected. The diagnosis issue owns that question.
- Removed from the original ticket: the AC requiring a regression test that fails before the fix. No such honest RED exists — the only RED available was "the helper module does not exist yet", which is an import error dressed as a deadlock test, i.e. exactly the hollow test P5 exists to catch.

SCOPE WIDENED 2026-09-19 to include plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/**. The lane measured 69 execPath spawn sites across THREE hook test dirs, 66 of them unbounded (claude-code 44/41, codex 20/20, copilot 5/5). AC1 is written against plugins/*/hooks/test/** so a guard that ignored copilot would fail on its own first run. Corrected inventory: 69 sites / 3 dirs (supersedes both the issue text and the earlier 63/2 figure).

RECONCILIATION NOTE: a parallel session converted the claude-code and codex sites to its own helper (helpers/run-node.mjs, exporting runNode) in the same worktree before stopping. That work is KEPT, not reverted; this lane unifies on ONE helper name per the normative decision above and repoints the imports. The conversion is therefore reconciled from two parallel sessions rather than authored in one pass.

CROSS-LANE CONTEXT: PR #1046 (issue #1043) MERGED, adding scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs with a shrink-only allowlist that currently lists several plugins/adlc-{claude-code,codex}/hooks/test/** files. A conversion that makes any of them compliant requires removing those entries, or the shrink-only test fails and names them.

Acceptance criteria:
1. No hook spawn under plugins/*/hooks/test/** lacks a timeout, proven by a drift guard that FAILS on a planted unbounded spawn and PASSES once removed (demonstrate both). Verify: node --test scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs
2. The guard names the offending file and line, and parses structurally so reformatting does not red it. Verify: node --test scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs
3. Every spawn site in both hook test dirs goes through the shared bounded runHook helper. Verify: node --test scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs
4. Existing wrapper timeout/kill tests pass unedited; an edit to one is a deviation that carries its own rationale. Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/wrapper-timeout-deny.test.mjs
5. The tmp-fixture allowlist from PR #1046 is consistent with this diff: any hook test file this lane makes compliant is removed from it. Verify: node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs
6. Full suite green from the repo root. Verify: npm test
7. The mutation gate exits 0 on the diff. A test-only diff mutates nothing: the gate prints "no source files changed" and exits 0, which measures zero mutable lines rather than test strength. Verify: node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12
title: Bound hook test spawns and add a spawn-timeout drift guard (#1042, defence-in-depth)
